name: How long does it take to install a drip irrigation system for a typical residential property?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a drip irrigation system for a typical residential property?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for a drip irrigation system on a residential property depends heavily on the project's scope and complexity. For a small garden or a few planting beds, it might take a single day. A medium-sized landscape with multiple zones could require 2-3 days. Larger or more intricate properties, especially those requiring extensive trenching, custom designs, or integration with smart home systems, may take a week or more. Our team provides an estimated timeline after the initial site assessment and design consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by project size, from one day for small gardens to several days or a week for larger, more complex residential landscapes.
